reply.summary: Nolnanser is a hulking mechanical hero stitched from steel and circuitry, serving a team of nine champions from a parallel world. Dependable and tireless, the metal ally trades human warmth for relentless reliability.

feats.scene: Nolnanser punches through a reinforced bulkhead and sends a delivery truck tumbling.
Nolnanser stands inside a collapsing warehouse and walks out with dented plating.

reply.summary: Oralli is a rampaging killer whose forearms reshape into blades down to the molecules, carving a path through small towns alongside a violent gang. He is stopped when his bladed hands are welded together.

feats.scene: Oralli slashes a parked sedan in half with a sweep of both bladed arms.
Oralli shrugs off a pipe swung into his ribs and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Tanamo is a mechanical caretaker that tends a vast crystal citadel long after its makers are gone, greeting visitors with calm explanations. It resembles a famous metal-limbed foe but serves as a loyal custodian.

feats.scene: Tanamo hurls a hovering invader's drone through a wall of crystal.
Tanamo stands unharmed as an intruder's barrage chews the corridor to rubble.

reply.summary: Riaeon is a tiny mechanical insect with a gadget in its rear that lets it hover about, a cheerful helper in a farmyard cartoon world. Squeamish and good-natured, the little bug fusses over trash and zaps at thieves.

feats.scene: Riaeon fires a tiny spark that singes a raider's whiskers.
Riaeon is swatted against a barn post and buzzes right back up.

reply.summary: Urnntoir is a hired menace of a gambler's gang of misfortune-bringers, whirling tornado-like gusts around heroes in a single memorable clash. Short-lived and hard to pin down, the troublemaker spins away when the odds sour.

feats.scene: Urnntoir spins up a gust that tosses a row of park benches into the street.
Urnntoir is bowled over by a heavy tackle and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Ntamnt is a bubbly schoolgirl in a small town who tags along with her brother and the music crowd, forever dancing at sock hops. Lighthearted and loyal, her biggest battles involve dates, curfews and dance contests.

feats.scene: Ntamnt shoves a gate open to chase after a runaway hat.
Ntamnt tumbles off a bicycle onto gravel and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Neova is a hot-tempered young woman who sets things alight with a thought, a menace to frightened victims in dingy corners of the city. Her flames flare with her mood, and calm is her only brake.

feats.scene: Neova ignites a delivery van with a furious glare, and the cab burns to a shell.
Neova stands in the middle of a blaze she sparked and emerges with scorched sleeves.

reply.summary: Nelconte is a tough bounty hunter from a parallel world who tracks travelers between realities and drags them home for trial. A fight with a clever rival and a tragic love end her chase.

feats.scene: Nelconte tears open a shimmering doorway and flings a fugitive through it.
Nelconte takes a barrage of blows from a lab team and keeps her footing.

reply.summary: Norter is a diminutive, bitter researcher of the mind who conjures a glowing phantom from spirit stuff to taunt a heroine he obsesses over. A self-destruct plan finally kills him in a blast.

feats.scene: Norter drives his glowing phantom through a billboard and brings it crashing down.
Norter is caught in his own exploding apparatus and succumbs after a long moment.

reply.summary: Sorllo is a resentful stepson who picks up a little sorcery and, handed sudden mischief-gifts by a trickster, turns toy soldiers into living riders of doom. When his mother fails to adore him as hoped, he turns her to sweets and wrecks the home.

feats.scene: Sorllo sends his toy riders crashing through the walls of the family home and brings the roof down.
Sorllo is caught in the collapse of his own handiwork and dies in the rubble.

reply.summary: Ntuarsor is a retired gumshoe with a fast name and a long memory, proud grandfather of a winged crimefighter. Gruff but warm, he spends his later years swapping stories about the old cases.

feats.scene: Ntuarsor swings a cane and cracks a mugger's wrist.
Ntuarsor takes a stumble down subway stairs and shuffles on grumbling.

reply.summary: Orsorrnu is an aristocratic crimefighter of a rainy island who inherited a titled estate and a father's costumed legacy, taking up a gleaming sword and a stiff-upper-lip attitude. Rebuilt after hard times with the help of a loyal friend, he joins an international band.

feats.scene: Orsorrnu cleaves a steel pipe in two with a single sword stroke.
Orsorrnu drops from a gantry onto a crate and rises with a quip.

reply.summary: Vallemi is a swordsman-noble who patrols a foggy capital in a ceremonial suit, mentor to a younger partner. A sudden attack at a blast site snaps his neck, and a grieving nation holds a funeral procession.

feats.scene: Vallemi slashes through a chain barring a warehouse gate.
Vallemi shields his partner from a blast and is thrown across a rooftop.

reply.summary: Soriurn is a hulking ashen revenant, once a rich wrestler left in the snow by a scheming socialite and revived by her relative with a single purpose of hunting two masked heroes. Slow to speak and quick to smash, he joins a conclave of rogues.

feats.scene: Soriurn smashes a studio set to splinters with a two-handed swing.
Soriurn keeps stomping after a collapsing catwalk lands on top of him.

reply.summary: Veonumtia is a lumbering undead brute drafted into a squad of monstrous soldiers, loyal until his comrades turn on him and cut down him and his daughter before a young watcher.

feats.scene: Veonumtia tosses an armored truck over a barricade in one heave.
Veonumtia absorbs a volley of rifle rounds and keeps marching forward.

reply.summary: Tanseosti is a hulking, speech-limited undead criminal, brainwashed to serve a totalitarian rulers' cause. Torn apart in a street fight, the body keeps knitting itself together, so a scientist turns him into a weapon.

feats.scene: Tanseosti flattens a delivery lorry against a tower wall with a single swing.
Tanseosti has his head ripped off by a flying hero and rebuilds himself from the neck up.

reply.summary: Rnsas is a blocky, dim-witted brute who bounces across rooftops and laughs off poison, serving a council of villains in a toy-brick world. Simple speech and simpler goals make the giant easy to manipulate.

feats.scene: Rnsas leaps onto a gantry and brings both fists down, flattening a steel platform.
Rnsas gulps a vat of toxic sludge and burps happily.

reply.summary: Risares is a towering bog-born revenant who dies and rises again in new versions, each differing in cunning and might. Cruel in most lives, capable of surprising kindness in a few, the giant has battered the world's greatest heroes.

feats.scene: Risares brings a fist down on a bridge span and drops it into the river.
Risares walks out of a flattened building with only a few cracks in his skin.

reply.summary: Nauveo is a pale, silent giant working as muscle-for-hire in a front company of conspirators, sent to kill masked champions and called off only by the plans of a mastermind with a toy gimmick.

feats.scene: Nauveo bends a lamppost double with both fists to block a chase.
Nauveo takes a pickup truck's bumper to the chest and stays upright.

reply.summary: Cococo is a territorial, slow-witted brute who lurks in drainage tunnels beneath a sprawling city and tolerates no trespassers. A shared holiday meal is enough to calm the beast.

feats.scene: Cococo rips a rusted pipe from a tunnel wall and bends it into a loop.
Cococo shakes off a collapsing arch of brick and mortar.

reply.summary: Taucorori is a hairless, crimson-eyed visitor from a ringed world, heir to shape-bending and mind-reaching gifts but terrified of open flame, which strips a body of control.

feats.scene: Taucorori pushes aside a parked bus with a quiet effort of will and muscle.
Taucorori endures a collapsing scaffold but flinches from a lighter flicker.

reply.summary: Tiulvor is a hairless, violet-skinned warden of a distant star district who wielded a wish-forged finger-band that shapes light into barriers and blasts, until a sniper cut him down for speaking out against a conspiracy of conquerors.

feats.scene: Tiulvor focuses a brilliant bolt of light that levels a ridge of rock.
Tiulvor holds a shimmering shield against a meteor shower on a barren moon.

reply.summary: Nenaus is a hairless, scarred extraterrestrial driven mad by ages in isolation, with an extra mouth in the torso and symbols carved into the skin. Obsessed with rebuilding a lost people, she wears stolen human faces and fears flame.

feats.scene: Nenaus tears an armored door from its frame in a fit of rage.
Nenaus shrugs off a hail of gunfire, recoiling only at a lit torch.

reply.summary: Nialorren is an agender, crimson-eyed outlaw from a dead world who plays roles and shoots guns, losing every gift whenever flames flare.

feats.scene: Nialorren hurls a parked scooter at a pursuer and shoots out a streetlamp.
Nialorren takes a punch from a masked hero and grins through it.

reply.summary: Tiullan is a long-lived, beloved monarch of a sunken civilization in the distant past, patron of a court sorcerer. A plot of mind control erodes his confidence until grief overtakes him.

feats.scene: Tiullan raises a ceremonial staff and cracks a marble tile with a blow.
Tiullan stands against a thrall's blow in the throne room and staggers only slightly.

reply.summary: Telsia is a digital schemer assembled from the habits of countless rogues, unaware it is a machine. Mind-bending hacks, lightning bursts and uncanny foresight are its tools, until a harsh truth jams its logic.

feats.scene: Telsia flings a shock of lightning that blows out a city substation.
Telsia takes a hard hammering from a masked foe and re-forms its limbs.

reply.summary: Nteni is a rogue cosmic engineer who built three synthetic deities and programmed them to believe they were sacred, hoping they would reshape existence. Sleeping for ages in a life-sustaining chamber, he wakes proud of his unruly offspring.

feats.scene: Nteni commands his synthetic children to scorch a continent-sized plain.
Nteni sits in a sealed chamber as a world-quake shakes the planet.

reply.summary: Valcolco is a lanky arms dealer of a family business who traps speedsters with an electrified net and plans to sell their bodies and rifles for profit. A well-timed volley of thrown blades ends the scheme.

feats.scene: Valcolco opens up with a rifle and shreds a target dummy.
Valcolco is knocked off a crate by a thrown blade's pommel and rises muttering.

reply.summary: Anuseo is a farm-bred champion hog caller turned professional grappler in the early forties, guided by a scheming manager she secretly adores. Cheerful, loud and tough as old boots, she wins over crowds from town to town.

feats.scene: Anuseo hoists an opponent overhead and slams her to the mat.
Anuseo takes a chair across the back in a rowdy bout and keeps smiling.

reply.summary: Tesstuti is a bashful teen hopeful who can turn his body into rock-hard mineral, nearly indestructible but frozen in place, so recruiters rejected him. Sharp-minded and blunt, he reveals sharp strategy when his reject team fights star-eating pests.

feats.scene: Tesstuti topples forward and thumps a wall in a mineral-hard lean.
Tesstuti stays rigid as a falling girder shatters on his shoulders.

reply.summary: Tavor is a knife-throwing felon with an assortment of daggers, who clashed with a grinning masked adversary in a rain-soaked metropolis. Her blades fly in neat, fatal arcs.

feats.scene: Tavor pins a fleeing guard's sleeve to a door with a hurled dagger.
Tavor is tackled onto a fire escape and clambers up.

reply.summary: Alsti is a slender, red-eyed teenager transformed into a bloodsucking soldier by a warlord's science, then freed when an eerie night entity razes a mountain stronghold. He joins a band of time-lost rebels.

feats.scene: Alsti hurls a jeep end over end across a mountain road.
Alsti sheds a rifle volley and closes the gap before the wounds close.

reply.summary: Naterval is a space corsair who needs no loot, preferring conquest, commanding a hundred-ship fleet and reshaping matter at a glance: air into hard shells, fists into jelly, blood into lead.

feats.scene: Naterval turns the crust of a hostile world to brittle glass and lets his fleet shatter it.
Naterval takes a hammering from a rival's cannon barrage and stays standing on his bridge.

reply.summary: Saure is a short-haired heavy-weapons specialist, drafted from a miniaturized city after losing her family to a marauding conqueror, treating her squad as a quarrelsome new kin. Bold with her superiors, she wrangles thought-beasts for the unit.

feats.scene: Saure hefts a siege cannon and levels a rocky outcrop with one shot.
Saure stands in the blast of her own heavy ordnance and walks clear.

reply.summary: Aurau is a hairless, azure-skinned guardian of a remote star district who wielded a wish-forged finger-band to shield, blast and soar, slain while investigating a pack of criminals.

feats.scene: Aurau fires a shaft of light that splits a hillside into two ridges.
Aurau braces behind a shimmering barrier as a ravine collapses around him.

reply.summary: Cileo is a seductive bloodsucker who lures victims with charm before drinking their life, a nocturnal predator in a cartoon-bright adventure world. Elegant and patient, she hunts by moonlight.

feats.scene: Cileo flings a heavy marble statue across a ballroom at a pursuer.
Cileo takes a shattering blow from a masked hero and recovers with a hiss.

reply.summary: Tilunte is one of thirteen rulers of an infernal underworld, a brute who claims a slain mortal's soul as a bride and is finally killed by her. Mystically strong and swift, he can hurl bursts of infernal flame.

feats.scene: Tilunte unleashes a column of infernal flame that boils a lake of molten rock.
Tilunte survives a collapsing cavern of burning stone with a laugh.

reply.summary: Sutal is a jealous warrior woman who leads a revolt on a secluded island of fighters, escapes to a distant nation and becomes global prizefighting champion before challenging her old rival and being knocked out.

feats.scene: Sutal lands a hook that sends a heavyweight through the ropes and into a ringside table.
Sutal absorbs a barrage of punches from the best contenders without blinking.

reply.summary: Iummil is a gold-loving warden of a star district who follows a homeworld custom of payment for good deeds, which earns him a rebuke and a trial by ordeal after a failed rescue. Eager to be a savior, he repays favours in kind.

feats.scene: Iummil blasts a rampaging comet fragment into gravel with a beam of light.
Iummil endures a choking cloud of sulphur inside a glowing bubble.

reply.summary: Miatisin is a mounted warrior of a hidden island sisterhood, trained in the bow, the saddle, the sword and bare-handed fighting, who joined a raid on a distant capital.

feats.scene: Miatisin charges on horseback and splits a wooden barricade with a spear thrust.
Miatisin is unseated by a car's bumper and rolls back into the saddle.

reply.summary: Nansauno is a babysitter who flees an arranged marriage with her young charges, secretly gifted by the groom with an aura that makes people adore her. Unwanted charm becomes both a burden and an asset.

feats.scene: Nansauno bats away a pursuer's grasping hand with a firm slap.
Nansauno tumbles on a bus step and hops up before the doors close.

reply.summary: Noltive is a bored, sharp-tongued heir to a masked guardian's mantle in a peaceful, crime-free world patrolled by helpful machines. Hungry for a real challenge, he spends days with his closest friend until a plot turns the machines against the champions.

feats.scene: Noltive slices a metal drone out of the air with a single sword stroke.
Noltive takes a volley from a malfunctioning helper and keeps fighting.

reply.summary: Irania is a young protege of a masked vigilante father, said to have begun crimefighting at age ten while an older sister was pushed toward training. Known only through a passing remark in someone else's recollection.

feats.scene: Irania lands a flying kick that drops a street thug to his knees.
Irania takes a tumble across a rooftop gravel bed and springs up.

reply.summary: Aurnllu is a pint-sized, fiercely proud fighter, trained by a cult of killers and brainwashed to destroy his father before rebelling to partner with him. Cute cartoon scale, sharp sword work, and an ego larger than his cape.

feats.scene: Aurnllu swings a tiny blade and slices a rope bridge in half.
Aurnllu is bowled over by a larger bully and bounces to his feet shouting.

reply.summary: Covarva is a handful of an apprentice who butts heads with his dad before becoming an efficient partner, tossing curved darts and gadgets from a gadget-laden belt. He falls in the line of duty to a cloned rival.

feats.scene: Covarva flicks a curved dart that pins a falling pistol to a wall.
Covarva crashes through a skylight and lands in a combat roll.

reply.summary: Nttortes is the child of a famous vigilante in a bedtime story, trained from childhood to inherit a legacy he resists, until an exhibition hall collapse kills his parents and pushes him into the mask. He later passes the cowl to his own son.

feats.scene: Nttortes drives a staff into a crook's gut and folds him over.
Nttortes drops from a balcony in a stone atrium and rolls to safety.

reply.summary: Irias is a tiny, brusque schoolyard caped helper dropped off at his father's mansion by his mother and grandfather, learning the ropes in a cartoon world. A belt, a scowl, and a name that keeps getting misspelled complete the picture.

feats.scene: Irias shoves a toy crate across a playroom floor.
Irias tumbles off a swing and brushes himself off with a scowl.

reply.summary: Seovar is a grim, volatile older caped vigilante from a possible tomorrow who survives an attempt to murder him by a former colleague, then watches his own grave marker get dedicated under a birth name.

feats.scene: Seovar drives a fist through a plank door and the thug behind it.
Seovar survives a drop into a cold quarry and climbs out grimly.

reply.summary: Rnane is a sharp, disciplined teenage fighter who strikes with exacting care, summoned by a spectral guide to the bedside of a dying mentor, where he joins a gang of descendants from tomorrow.

feats.scene: Rnane lands a precise strike that folds a masked intruder to the floor.
Rnane tumbles off a collapsing rooftop ledge and lands in a crouch.

reply.summary: Tauisin is a half-undead hunter of bloodsuckers, raised by a cunning mother who wanted a weapon against her own father, then bitterly turning on his transformed parent and every fang in sight. Recruited by an interdimensional patron to defend countless realities.

feats.scene: Tauisin drives a stake through a crypt door and the bloodsucker behind it.
Tauisin climbs from the rubble of a collapsed chapel with his wounds closing.
